verdict.why: Flagship bindings now use the local Miniflare store by default instead of the remote app unless `remote: true` is set.

draft.detail: Flagship bindings use the local Miniflare store by default; set remote: true on a binding to use its remote app.

test.error: FAIL: flagship binding without remote: true is sent to the remote proxy instead of the local store

source.quote: Flagship bindings now use the local Miniflare store by default in Wrangler and the Vite plugin, keeping development offline and isolated from production flags. Set `remote: true` on a binding to continue using its remote app.
